facts.fact: 训练后的 Rory 泡在茉莉香浴里缓解酸痛——这是她找回力量、朝能自卫并保护 Cora 又迈一步的代价；因 Gabriel 以「淑女不该在泥里打滚」为由拒绝教她打架，她打算私下自己练 Darragh 教的动作。
facts.anchor: Waves of long ash-brown hair floated around me as my head hovered just above the surface of the jasmine-scented water.

facts.fact: Gabriel 本说带 Cora 上课要过一阵才回，却中途折返；他在 Rory 床上留了一条花瓣粉、satin over tulle 的裙子作礼物。Rory 嫌它骑马不便、显眼又不保暖，仍被迫穿上，只在里面加穿打底裤。
facts.anchor: “I left something for you on your bed.” He smiled, and I watched as he strode out the door.

facts.fact: Celeste 在一场「意外」中把 Rory 摔下后离去了；Gabriel 惊讶并提出同乘被她推辞，她改骑马厩老手 Ketlus 牵来的黑马。Ketlus 今天异常沉默、应答比平时生硬，交接后一瘸一拐匆匆走开。
facts.anchor: Gabriel was stunned to learn that Celeste had taken off after an unfortunate “accident” that threw me from her. He offered to have me ride with him, but I, probably too quickly, declined, taking the first available horse offered to me by my favorite gnarled-fingered stable hand. Ketlus was unusually quiet today as he readied our horses.

facts.fact: 珠宝摊上 Rory 自己挑了条水滴形蓝宝石小金项链；Gabriel 又替她加挑一颗粉光珍珠配黑色天鹅绒颈圈——她觉得颈圈像「牲口套具」的象征但没吭声，Gabriel 数硬币付了两件的钱。
facts.anchor: I selected a simple gold necklace with a small teardrop-shaped sapphire. It was dainty and understated, just how I liked it.

facts.fact: 一位年长女性突然抓过 Rory 手腕看掌纹（文中先称 daemonite 妇人——银发垂腰、靛蓝眼睛，Gabriel 随后却骂作 elder seraph）；她预言 Clotha 对 Rory 有安排、「你把两个世界撞在了一起、带来改变」。
facts.anchor: Delicate fingers snatched my wrist, and I turned to face an older daemonite woman, hunched over and studying my palm close to her face.

facts.fact: Gabriel 打掉老人的手，斥其言论亵渎、威胁送她去 atoner（赎罪者）；Rory 喝止他，老人毫无惧色，对 Rory 微笑颔首后没入人群。
facts.anchor: He waved his hand dismissively at her. “Your words are blasphemy! Be gone, or I will send you to the atoner!”

facts.fact: 小巷里 Rory 提出猜想：angheals 生不出幼童，也许是因为他们不再建庙、设坛、献祭敬奉生命女神 Danu；Gabriel 立刻把她抵到墙边圈住，说这话足以送 atoner，但准她说完这一次。
facts.anchor: Have the angheals maybe thought that the reason no younglings are being born to your people is that no devotions, altars, or temples are made to honor Danu, the Goddess of Life?

facts.fact: Rory 摆出家乡实情：Edenalee 收成减少、牲畜减少、出生率因经济困难下降，还有暴动、人类接连失踪；Gabriel 只信古籍所载「Themis 是唯一真神、曾击败篡位的伪神」，要她此后永不再提，还说 Edenalee 不稳定、更该让她和 Cora 留下。
facts.anchor: In Edenalee, the humans are experiencing upheavals. Crops are becoming less plentiful, livestock are dwindling, and we have a decreasing birth rate due to economic hardship and lack of resources.

facts.fact: Gabriel 定下赎罪：今晚两人去庭院的 Themis 独石（monolith）前，Rory 只需刺破指尖滴几滴血、保证不再想不再说；他强调这不是送 atoner，但不兑现的话 backlash 会很严重——Rory 只得应下。
facts.anchor: Just a small prick of the finger and a few drops of blood with a promise not to think or speak this way again.
